description: This file defines the DelinquencyRangeData class, a data container used within the delinquency module of the Fineract project. It includes fields for id, classification, and age range, along with static factory methods.

classes.name: DelinquencyRangeData
classes.description: A data class holding information about delinquency ranges, including classification and age bounds, with utility methods for creation and referencing.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new DelinquencyRangeData object with specified classification and age bounds, without an id.

methods.name: reference
methods.description: Static method to create a placeholder DelinquencyRangeData object with only an id, used for referencing existing records.
